Among the following classical ballet steps, which has the ending leg position the same as the starting position? 

Answer Choices:
A. Entrechat six
B. Échappé battu changé
C. Assemblé
D. Glissade derrière
E. Gargouillade

Entrechat six starts in fifth position and, because it has an even number of beats/crossings, lands back in fifth position with the same foot in front as at the start. By contrast, Échappé battu changé explicitly changes feet, and the other listed steps generally involve a change of the working leg’s position or closing cross.
